links.outcome: MCI screening accuracy of GPT-4 versus three junior neurologists on same participant corpus
links.effect: GPT-4 accuracy 0.81 versus neurologists 0.41 to 0.49; GPT-4 discriminated MCI better, p < 0.001
links.quote: Results showed that the GPT-4 model had higher accuracy (0.81) compared to the neurologists (ranging from 0.41 to 0.49).

screen.reason: The study empirically compares the diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4 against junior neurologists for detecting Mild Cognitive Impairment using text/voice corpus, but does not test an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
